headline: M.S. in Meteorology
text: Completed Master's degree in Meteorology at University of Melbourne, Australia.

headline: Ph.D. Studies Begin
text: Started doctoral research in Atmospheric Sciences at Macquarie University, Sydney.

headline: Ph.D. Completed
text: Earned Ph.D. in Atmospheric Sciences from Macquarie University.

headline: University of Arizona
text: Postdoctoral researcher and then research faculty at University of Arizona.

headline: Joins UT Austin Faculty
text: Appointed to faculty in Department of Geological Sciences at University of Texas at Austin.

headline: Joseph C. Walter Jr. Excellence Award
text: Received the most prestigious internal award in the Jackson School of Geosciences.

headline: NCAR CCSM Distinguished Achievement Award
text: Shared NCAR 2008 CCSM Distinguished Achievement Award for contributions to climate modeling.

headline: Co-Chair of NCAR Land Working Group
text: Appointed Co-Chair of the NCAR Community Climate System Model Land Working Group.

headline: Noah-MP Model Published
text: Published landmark papers on the Community Noah Land Surface Model with Multi-Parameterization Options.

headline: Hurricane Harvey Forecasting
text: Yang's Noah-MP model proved critical in accurately forecasting Hurricane Harvey's extreme rainfall and flooding impacts.

headline: Jackson Chair in Earth System Sciences
text: Holds the John A. and Katherine G. Jackson Chair in Earth System Sciences at UT Austin.

headline: Elected AGU Fellow
text: Elected as American Geophysical Union Fellow for exemplary leadership and outstanding scientific achievements in land surface interactions and climate modeling.
